FISHING LICENCE · UNITED STATES

Wyoming fishing licence

Anglers aged 14 or older generally need a fishing licence. A state licence does not provide Yellowstone National Park fishing coverage.

Official rules ↗

Updated 2026-11-11

Who needs one

  • Residents and visitors aged 14 or older, unless exempt.

Who doesn’t

  • Non-residents under 14 can fish with an adult who holds a valid Wyoming fishing licence; catch-limit conditions apply.

Licence options and prices

LicenceForLengthPrice
Non-resident dailynon resident1 day$14 USD
Non-resident 5-daynon resident5 consecutive days$56 USD
Non-resident annualnon resident12 months$102 USD
Non-resident youth annual, under 18non resident12 months$15 USD

Extra stamps and permits

  • Conservation Stamp · $21.50 USD
    Required with most annual fishing licences; daily licences have an exemption.
  • Yellowstone National Park permit
    Required separately under park rules; see the federal record.

Rules visitors should know

  • The annual licence lasts 12 months.
  • Yellowstone has separate fishing permit rules.

How to buy

Use the department's official licence purchase service.

Common license questions

Do I need a fishing licence in Wyoming?

Anglers aged 14 or older generally need a fishing licence. A state licence does not provide Yellowstone National Park fishing coverage.

How much is a visitor fishing licence in Wyoming?

Non-resident daily: $14 USD; Non-resident 5-day: $56 USD; Non-resident annual: $102 USD; Non-resident youth annual, under 18: $15 USD (checked November 2026).

Where do I buy a fishing licence in Wyoming?

Use the department's official licence purchase service.
